source_preservation.normalization: Comments, whitespace and import lines only.
source_preservation.private_name_note: The generated private helper name follows its new module; public declaration names are preserved.

scope: Project-only imports and declaration placement; no mathematical or functional change.

metric_definitions.reachable_pairs: Ordered project module-to-transitive-dependency pairs, excluding self and external packages.
metric_definitions.performance_limit: Graph measurements; not a timing or cache-hit benchmark.

publication_validation: Checkpoint must validate aggregate and all changed child modules, including upstream integration. Terminal result reported with delivery.
